reason: The README describes forge_plugin as an AI-driven plugin development tool that delegates implementation, validates builds, migrates results into repositories, commits changes, and optionally installs and hot-mounts generated plugins.

summaries.zh: 一个通过子代理开发、构建、迁移、提交并可选安装和热挂载 DeepSeek Harness 插件的插件生成工具。
summaries.en: A plugin generator that uses subagents to develop, build, migrate, commit, and optionally install and hot-mount DeepSeek Harness plugins.

capabilities: writes and migrates plugin files into independent repositories
runs pnpm install, typecheck, test, and build workflows
creates git commits and updates a local plugin registry
installs generated plugins into a profile and hot-mounts them into the runtime
